title: Ensure 'Enable Windows NTP Client' is set to 'Enabled'
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Windows Time Service\Time Providers\Enable Windows NTP Client to 'Enabled'
reason: A reliable and accurate account of time is important for a number of services and security requirements, including distributed applications, authentication services, and logging services.

title: Ensure 'Enable Windows NTP Server' is set to 'Disabled' (MS only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Windows Time Service\Time Providers\Enable Windows NTP Server to 'Disabled'
reason: The configuration of proper time synchronization is critically important. Member servers and workstations should not typically be time sources for other clients.
